raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions casts raw amount to DECIMAL without considering currency, so 83 EUR rows are summed as USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates has a single static EUR rate (1.25) effective 2026-01-01, before all transactions, so the conversion is determinable.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.75,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
